info.title: Moovha Wallet Provider Service
info.description: Experimental wallet-provider API with application-led access and optional hosted compatibility. Signing returns an approved EIP-712 signature; it does not submit a transaction or pay gas. Optional approved-transfer execution coordinates signing, simulation and sponsored submission through a durable attempt; independent RPC checks verify transfer effects and finality. Application transaction-event reports remain unverified and do not establish settlement. General contract calls require a stored policy-approved action and the explicit Safe execution profile; no blind signing or direct arbitrary-submission endpoint is exposed. Optional bounded Safe request queues authorize delayed execution under fresh current authority; configurable sponsor pools retain one selected payer per execution. Not the Moovha operation orchestration API.

serviceProof.description: Request-bound proof produced by the designated executor. Application tokens and private keys are not accepted here; this callback cannot be executed by the application-token explorer.

post.description: Reserve an owner-enrollment challenge through current host policy and durable storage. No wallet is created.
Submit a provider-nonce-bound OIDC Identity Assurance ID token. Provider policy decides acceptance; this never creates a wallet or spend grant.

get.description: Read the current authorized enrollment receipt without identity attributes or the proof token.

post.description: Provision a host-authorized account by stored ID with an empty body and durable attempt. When enrollment is configured, current provider acceptance for the same caller/account/owner is also required. Acceptance does not grant signing rights.
Requires current owner/grant/KYC authority and a durable attempt. Never retry an unknown outcome blindly. The body must be an empty object.

Fixed Base Sepolia ERC-3009 transfer authorization. Explicit transfer delegation, current owner-bound access, identity and provider policy authorization are required. No per-transfer owner prompt. No broadcast or settlement.

get.description: Fixed Base Sepolia ERC-3009 transfer authorization. Explicit transfer delegation, current owner-bound access, identity and provider policy authorization are required. No per-transfer owner prompt. No broadcast or settlement.

post.description: Request an immutable approved contract call, Uniswap V3 exact-input swap or bounded ERC-4626 router deposit. Requires separately consented contracts:request delegation, current owner/grant/KYC/consent and configured target policies. The service constructs the Safe transaction and reserves its nonce; callers never supply signatures or a signing payload.

Authority callback for the configured designated executor. Initial dispatch requires the exact stored plan/attempt and an unexpired handoff lease. Optional bounded replacements require a separate durable proposal, fresh RPC nonce/fee evidence and a short replacement lease. Every effect rechecks current owner, grant, KYC, consent, immutable approval and active revision. Application OAuth tokens do not authenticate this endpoint.

get.description: Public versioned execution discovery. Profile implementation, configuration and service readiness do not establish live-provider certification or production custody acceptance. Clients must select an exact supported ID/revision and ignore unknown profiles.

parameters.name: execution-profile
parameters.description: Select the exact execution contract from GET /v1/execution-capabilities.

parameters.name: execution-profile-revision
parameters.description: Unknown revisions are rejected; the server never substitutes a different execution contract.

outcome_scope.description: What verified success establishes: exact token transfer, successful approved calls, or the required swap/vault asset effects. Contract execution alone does not prove an arbitrary business outcome.

dispatch_status.description: Durable submission state. Accepted identifies a durable executor/provider acceptance; it is not chain inclusion or settlement.

verification.description: RPC quorum means agreement of all configured trusted RPC sources on exact receipt effects and canonical block evidence, not a cryptographic light-client proof.

settlement.description: The supported token transfer reaches succeeded/reverted settlement only after matching finalized chain evidence. This is not a claim of general business-operation completion.

execution_origin.description: An external party can relay the same ERC-3009 authorization. Only its exact verified token effect can establish success.

post.description: Optional immutable approved-action execution with exact version selection, current owner/grant/identity/consent/approval checks, durable signing and submission authority, application gas sponsorship and independent RPC receipt/finality verification. Unknown provider submission outcomes never permit redispatch. Contract calls require the approved-evm-executor-v1 profile and a stored policy-approved action; execute never accepts replacement calldata.

get.description: Authenticated CloudEvents 1.0 execution observations with a monotonic sequence in the active store. At most 64 transitions are retained per execution; history_truncated signals a cursor gap requiring verified-status resynchronization. Reports never become verified events without RPC evidence. This endpoint does not refresh, submit or release budgets.

post.description: Optional account-scoped EIP-5792 2.0.0 JSON-RPC transport. Runtime financial authority, an explicitly bound Safe relayer or ERC-4337 driver, current owner consent and method-specific scopes remain required. wallet_sendCalls admits a durable atomic batch without waiting for chain inclusion. Headless wallet_showCallsStatus returns unsupported method; the client adapter can present status through an explicit host callback.

schema.description: Single account-scoped JSON-RPC request. SendCallsParams uses EIP-5792 version 2.0.0. JSON-RPC batch envelopes and notifications are not accepted.

requestBody.description: Single account-scoped JSON-RPC request. SendCallsParams uses EIP-5792 version 2.0.0. JSON-RPC batch envelopes and notifications are not accepted.

get.description: Optional runtime configuration control plane. Application proposals and provider publications are configuration records, not wallet grants, signing authority or execution activation. Publications become readable immediately without restarting the service. Immutable historical revisions remain available. Requires the documented scope and configured application or operator identity.
